create_NavGoalPointGoalSensor: create a GPS and compass sensor that returns polar coordinates relative to the robot base transformation and navigation goal position
create_OracleNavigationActionSensor: create an oracle navigation sensor that computes shortest path waypoints using Habitat's pathfinder for navigation targets
build_NavToObjReward: build a reward measure combining distance-to-goal and rotation-to-goal metrics with configurable turn reward distance thresholds
create_DistToGoal: create a measure that computes the 2D Euclidean distance between the robot base position and the navigation goal position
create_NavToObjSuccess: create a success measure checking navigation position proximity, optional angle alignment, and optional stop action termination requirements
